name: Square Tube Corner Bracket
process: laser-cut flat pattern, press-brake formed: the two outer edges are bent 90 degrees to form the flanges
design_notes: L-shaped bracket formed from a single flat sheet: the flat L-shaped blank bolts to the top faces of two square tubes (tube_size x tube_size) meeting at a right-angle corner, and its two outer edges are bent 90 degrees down to form flanges that wrap the outer side face of each tube, so bolts can go into a second face per tube. The bracket is modeled as three unioned solids (plate + 2 flanges, each flange with a small miter-fill piece at the bend) that form one continuous, correctly connected part with a sharp (zero-radius) inside corner at each bend -- representative of a tight press-brake bend at this thickness. (An explicit inside bend-radius fillet was attempted but the fillet operation failed where it interacts with the plate's other corner fillets; the sharp bend is left in place rather than a broken/guessed fillet.) Leg width equals tube_size; leg_length and flange_height are derived from tube_size (3x and 2/3x respectively) so they stay proportional if tube_size changes. Each leg and each flange carries 2 slotted bolt holes (width hole_d = 6.5 mm for M6 clearance, slot_play of travel) positioned hole_end_dist from the far end and hole_corner_margin clear of the corner so slots never overlap. The reflex inner corner of the flat blank is filleted (corner_fillet_r) for stress relief, and the outer corners are broken (outer_corner_fillet_r) for safety. Assumes light-duty framing load; for heavy structural loads increase plate_t or add a gusset. The two flanges meet at a closed/mitered corner post near the origin (touching only along an edge, not sharing volume) rather than a flat-pattern relief cut; fine for laser+brake with a corner weld or tight forming.

features.name: bracket plate
features.intent: L-shaped bracket plate connecting two square tubes (tube_size x tube_size) at a right-angle corner; sits on top of both tube faces
round the inner corner to relieve stress concentration where the two legs meet

between.note: side face swept from the leg_a_top line
side face swept from the inner_corner line

edges.note: vertical edge at the reflex inner corner of the L, where the two legs meet

features.name: bolt slots
features.intent: 4x slotted clearance cuts (2 per leg, hole_d wide, slot_play of travel along the leg) for M6 bolts, allowing minor position adjustment along each tube before tightening
round the 5 sharp outer corners of the plate for safety/deburring (the reflex inner corner already has its own larger stress-relief fillet)
